Unset data_as_elements uses span and div for data-as

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
